messages:
sam: Hey team — quick review pls for PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4829. Adds a secondary GPU subnet + route table for the batch GPU pool. Changes: new route table, NAT GW association, EIP with prevent_destroy. Ran staging plan and smoke tests. Hoping to merge in tonight's 01:00 PST merge window. Can someone take a look? :eyes:

anya: Taking a look now, planning to run the plan locally and check drift. Any special var files I should use?

sam: Use `tfvars/prod-like.tfvars` (same vars used in staging run). I ran `terraform plan -var-file=...` and attached the relevant diff snippet in the PR. No destroy operations except the EIP replacement which is guarded by `prevent_destroy`.

devan: Quick q — will this touch ENI attachments on existing GPU nodes? i'm worried about brief detaches.

sam: No detach. This only creates a new subnet + route table and associates it with the GPU ASG for batch workers. We'll roll new instances; existing ENIs untouched.

marta: left a tiny nit in the PR about the naming of the route table tag. Otherwise looks sane. :thumbsup: 

terraform-bot: CI plan check passed — `plan.txt` attached (sha: 3b7a2f).

anya: Ran `terraform plan` locally, no diffs vs what CI showed. Two minor comments on docs + tags, otherwise LGTM from me. :white_check_mark:

devan: I'll take a full review in ~20m, can do a manual smoke in staging after you push the canary.

sam: thanks. canary will be 2 instances in staging, then promote. I'll create a canary playbook in the PR.

marta: approve once sam addresses the tag nit.

infra-leads: @sam please ping when ready for infra-leads approval. We need to confirm the EIP billing note.

sam: done — addressed tag nit, added playbook, noted EIP cost in PR description.

devan: LGTM, no infra-level blockers from me. :+1:

infra-leads: Acked for merge window. Please merge during 01:00 PST and monitor GPU pool scaling. Set rollback plan.

sam: Will merge at 01:05 PST after final CI. I'll post status here and open a post-merge follow-up.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline passed on merge candidate. All checks green.

sam: merged and applied during window. Post-apply smoke was green. Closing the thread. :tada:
